title: Add Max Children to Port and Type Connector
description: Extend port to optionally have a maxChildren (integer) which defaults to 1. Add the same to the connector of types. When both are set, the more specific wins (type connector is more specific than port). When maxChildren is set, no more connections can be connected. Extend all tests, assets, implementations, etc for all programming languages, schema, specs, docs, etc.
summary:
Added optional `maxChildren` (integer, default 1, minimum 0) to Port and Connector across all languages, schemas, specs, docs, and tests.

Implementation:
- TypeScript (Zod): PortSchema, ConnectorSchema, diff functions
- Go: Port, PortDiff, PortMeta, Connector, ConnectorDiff, ConnectorMeta structs
- Python (Pydantic): PortMaxChildrenField/ConnectorMaxChildrenField mixins added to all Port*/Connector* classes
- C# .NET: Port, PortDiff, PortMeta, Connector, ConnectorDiff, ConnectorMeta + SQLite persistence (Save/Load)
- Rust (serde): Port, PortDiff, PortMeta, Connector, ConnectorDiff, ConnectorMeta
- Ruby: Connector Struct

Schemas: JSON Schema (kit.json, type.json), GraphQL, OWL, XMI, SHACL, OpenAPI, Liveblocks, SQLite schema.sql

Server: Rust server PostgreSQL DDL + load_ports query, PortState/ConnectorState structs

UI: KitPortArtifact and KitConnectorArtifact interfaces

Bug fixes: Fixed pre-existing .NET nullable parameter bugs in SaveQuality, SaveType, SaveBenchmark, SaveLayer, SaveConnector

Tests (all passing):
- TypeScript: 151 tests (17 new maxChildren tests)
- Go: 4 new maxChildren tests
- Python: 66 tests (9 new maxChildren tests)
- C# .NET: 66 tests (4 new maxChildren tests)
- Rust: 58 tests (4 new maxChildren tests)
